title: Export selected authorized inventory-aging page to Excel
description: An inventory user downloads exactly the selected dynamic stock-aging page as xlsx in chosen field order. Reuse ERP-135 authorized bounded preview, existing ExcelExporter and current-user stock-query menu on every download. Keep fixed age buckets, base-unit quantities and CNY cost currency; unknown cost amounts remain explicitly unknown rather than zero and formula-leading text is literal. HTTP audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify workbook tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses authorized bounded stock-aging preview and selected fields, rechecks stock-query permission and rejects invalid filters/columns/page size before bytes.
Workbook uses existing ExcelExporter for only the current page in selected order; unknown cost amounts remain explicitly unknown, base units and CNY are labeled, and formula-leading text is escaped.
Designer offers xlsx download and visible empty/authorization errors; tests inspect field order, row cap, unknown amounts, bucket values, formula safety and permission; document limits.
